purpose: Teach: ワークス/昨年度/前記/隻/女史/船長/無職/北東

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、機動隊のワークスに連携されますね
lines.en: The police will coordinate with the riot control units, won't they?
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. Speaking as though confirming what's already known. Slight upward lift on the final particle, not questioning but inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、昨年度の検挙数を公表されますね
lines.en: The police will release last year's arrest figures, won't they?
lines.style: Same measured confidence. Reciting facts with gentle approval. Pace unhurried, almost procedural—the tone of someone who trusts the process.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の前記の通り、捜査されますね
lines.en: The police will conduct the investigation exactly as stated in the statement, won't they?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Nodding certainty in the voice. References the paperwork with quiet respect for the procedure. Steady cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、密輸船一隻を押収されますね
lines.en: The police will seize that smuggling vessel, won't they?
lines.style: Firm, factual delivery. Light emphasis on the action. No doubt in the voice—stating what will happen. Businesslike but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者女史の支援もされますね
lines.en: The police will provide support to the victim as well, won't they?
lines.style: Gentle emphasis on 'as well'—caring that she's not forgotten. Voice softens slightly. Still confident, but now with an undertone of concern for fairness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、船長の供述も丁寧に聴取されますね
lines.en: The police will listen carefully to the captain's statement, won't they?
lines.style: Respectful, attentive cadence. The word 'carefully' carries weight—approval of due diligence. Measured pace, almost solemn.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、無職の被疑者にも公平に対応されますね
lines.en: The police will treat the unemployed suspect fairly too, won't they?
lines.style: Quiet conviction on 'fairly.' Emphasis on 'too'—ensuring no one is overlooked. Slightly firmer than before, a hint of gentle insistence beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、北東方面のパトロールを強化されますね
lines.en: The police will increase patrols in the northeastern sector, won't they?
lines.style: Closer, more personal. Slightly lower volume, as if sharing a practical detail with someone who understands. Less ceremonial, more direct hand-off of information.
